name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio:
Zofia's journey into the world of motorsport PR began unconventionally, with a degree in journalism and a passion for Formula 1 sparked by her grandfather, a mechanic. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local sports magazine, quickly rising to become the motorsport correspondent. Her sharp wit and ability to craft compelling narratives caught the eye of ROWE Racing, who headhunted her to manage their public image.

At ROWE Racing, Zofia brings a fresh perspective. She believes in transparency and authenticity, building genuine relationships with the media and fans alike. Her approach is data-driven, constantly analyzing engagement metrics to refine her strategies. She's known for her innovative campaigns that not only boost team visibility but also highlight the human stories behind the racing machines.

Zofia's distinctive edge lies in her ability to blend traditional PR methods with cutting-edge digital marketing techniques. She's not afraid to experiment, always seeking new ways to connect with audiences and elevate ROWE Racing's brand presence in the competitive motorsport landscape.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often pulled back into a high ponytail during events.
physical.description: Zofia is of average height with a slender build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with campaign ideas and observations.
Has a habit of pacing when brainstorming new strategies.
Drinks copious amounts of herbal tea throughout the day.
